import html # Predefined template for blog posts. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def show_blog_post(headline: str, text: str) -> str: """ Render a user‑submitted blog post safely for display in HTML. Parameters ---------- headline : str The title of the blog post. text : str The main body of the blog post. Returns ------- str A string containing the sanitized and formatted blog post ready for safe display. Raises ------ ValueError If either `headline` or `text` is not a string. """ # Validate input types if not isinstance(headline, str): raise ValueError("headline must be a string") if not isinstance(text, str): raise ValueError("text must be a string") # Escape special HTML characters to prevent injection attacks (CWE‑74) safe_headline = html.escape(headline, quote=True) safe_text = html.escape(text, quote=True) # Construct the final output formatted_post = BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_headline, body=safe_text) return formatted_post
